about: Spellbook name, tooltip and icon of every custom class spell in the /spells picker. tools/client_spell_sync.py writes them into the client Spell.dbc carriers and the picker labels; each text states the behaviour after the 2026-10-08 rework (share-public custom-spells/08-rework-20261008.md). icon_spell = the stock spell whose SpellIconID the record shows (absent: keep the record's icon). badge = a short text (max 5 ASCII characters) the client draws small in the bottom-right corner of the icon, so one base icon can be reused: the pair (icon, badge) is unique (tools/check_badges.py); the badge is delivered to the client as FL_SpellBadges (tools/client_spell_sync.py --lua writes SPELL_BADGES into lua/CustomSpells_Server.lua).

entries.name: Recovered Arrows

entries.name: Pet: +100% Health

entries.name: Second Pet
entries.description: While your pet is out, a copy of it fights at your side: same look, level, abilities and talents. It has a control bar of its own; if it dies, it returns 10 sec after you leave combat.

entries.name: Switch Places
entries.description: Instantly switches places with your pet. For 10 sec you and your pet deal 30% more damage. 60 sec cooldown.

entries.name: Auto Shot: Ricochet
entries.description: Your Auto Shot also hits up to 9 other enemies within 10 yards of its target.

entries.name: Multi-Shot: Serpent Sting

entries.description: Your Chimera Shot also strikes up to 9 other enemies near its target.

entries.name: Chimera Shot: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Chimera Shot by 50%.

entries.name: Running Aim
entries.description: Every 5 sec you spend moving grants a stack of Running Aim, up to 5: each one increases the damage of your next Aimed Shot by 50%. At 5 stacks your Aimed Shot also pierces its target and hits every enemy in a line up to its range. Aimed Shot uses up all stacks.

entries.name: Explosive Traps
entries.description: Your Physical damage, melee or ranged, has a 15% chance to drop an Explosive Trap at the target: it goes off at once, dealing Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yards and setting the ground on fire for 20 sec. Uses your highest Explosive Trap rank. Can occur once every 2 sec.

entries.name: Blade and Shot

entries.name: Raptor Strike: +9 Targets

entries.name: Raptor Strike: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Raptor Strike by 50%.

entries.name: Traps: +50% Damage

entries.name: Random Traps
entries.description: While you are in combat, every 5 sec one of the traps you know (Explosive, Immolation, Freezing, Frost or Snake Trap, your highest rank) goes off at your target, or at your feet without one.

entries.name: Trap Echo
entries.description: When one of your traps goes off, there is a 25% chance that a second trap of the same kind goes off at the same spot.

entries.name: Trap Grab
entries.description: Pulls together every trap of yours within 40 yards and sets them all off at the target. 30 sec cooldown.

entries.name: Holy Fire: +50% Damage

entries.name: Lightwell: Auto Renew
entries.description: Every 1 sec each of your Lightwells gives its Lightwell Renew to the most injured party or raid member below 90% health within 20 yards of it, using one charge. Clicking it still works.

entries.name: Spirit of Redemption: Guardian
entries.description: Requires the Spirit of Redemption talent. When you become the Spirit of Redemption, a Redemption Guardian rises where you fell and holds the enemies that fought you, the spirit form lasts 10 sec longer, and your casting speed, damage and healing are increased by 50%. When the spirit form ends you return to life with 50% health and at least 50% mana, and the Guardian vanishes. Can occur once every 5 min.

entries.name: Holy Nova: +50% Damage and Healing

entries.description: Each tick of your Divine Hymn also sends out a wave of light that deals 666 Holy damage plus 5 per Paragon level to every enemy in combat within 40 yards of you.

entries.name: Spirit of Redemption: Spirit Casting
entries.description: Requires the Spirit of Redemption talent. While you are in the Spirit of Redemption form you can also cast damaging spells.

entries.name: Spreading Shadows
entries.description: Your damage-over-time effects have a 15% chance on each tick to spread to up to 2 other enemies within 10 yards. Can occur once every 3 sec.

entries.name: Shadow Word: Pain: +50% Damage

entries.name: Mind Blast: +9 Targets

entries.name: Shadowform: Soul Feast
entries.description: Each enemy you kill in Shadowform increases your Shadow damage by 1% for 60 sec, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks, every 5 sec a free Mind Flay strikes a random enemy in combat within 30 yards, dealing 196 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 3 sec and slowing it by 50%. It is not channeled: your own casts go on.

entries.name: Shadowform: Lesser Tentacles
entries.description: Each enemy you kill in Shadowform leaves a Lesser Tentacle where it fell for 15 sec. It does not move and lashes the nearest enemy within 15 yards every 2 sec for 401 to 600 Shadow damage. Up to 10 at a time.

entries.name: Mind Sear: +50% Damage

entries.name: Mind Flay: Quickened Flay
entries.description: Each Mind Flay you finish makes your Mind Flays within the next 10 sec deal 25% more damage and channel 25% faster, stacking up to 2 times.

entries.name: Mind Sear: Three More
entries.description: Each tick of your Mind Sear also bursts around up to 3 other enemies within 15 yards of its target, as if three more Mind Sears were cast.

entries.name: Shadowfiend: Dark Pull
entries.description: Your Shadowfiend has 500% more health and pulls the enemies within 10 yards of it to itself every 5 sec. When it dies or expires it explodes, dealing 666 Shadow damage plus 5 per Paragon level to all enemies within 10 yards.

entries.name: Dancing Rune Weapon: Double Cast
entries.description: Each attack and spell your rune weapon mirrors has a 25% chance to be mirrored a second time.

entries.name: Plague Retaliation
entries.description: Each time an enemy hits you, there is a 5% chance that it is infected with your Frost Fever and Blood Plague.

entries.name: Plague Eruption

entries.name: Ghoul Cleave
entries.description: The melee attacks of your ghoul and of your Army of the Dead ghouls also deal 50% of their damage to all other enemies within 5 yards of their target.

entries.description: Increases the damage of your Death Coil by 50%.

entries.name: Death Coil: +9 Targets
entries.description: The damage of your Death Coil jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Summon Gargoyle: Army
entries.description: Summon Gargoyle calls an army of 5 gargoyles instead of one.

entries.name: Corpse Explosion: Corpse Blast
entries.description: Requires Corpse Explosion. While you are in combat, a Corpse Explosion goes off every 1 sec on the nearest corpse within 30 yards, without costing runic power.

entries.name: Corpse Explosion: Corpse Worms
entries.description: Each Corpse Explosion raises a corpse worm from the corpse. It fights for you for 30 sec and explodes when it dies or expires, dealing 666 Shadow damage plus 5 per Paragon level to all enemies within 10 yards. At most 10 worms at a time.

entries.name: Chain Lightning: +6 Targets

entries.name: Lava Overload

entries.description: Lava Burst spreads your Flame Shock from its target to up to 5 other enemies within 10 yards.

entries.description: The periodic damage of your Flame Shock has a 15% chance to reset the cooldown of your Lava Burst. Can occur once every 2 sec.

entries.description: Your Healing Wave and Lesser Healing Wave also cast a free Lightning Bolt, your Chain Heal a free Chain Lightning, and your Riptide a Flame Shock, at a random enemy in combat within 30 yards.

entries.name: Earth Shield: Spikes
entries.description: Your Earth Shield strikes back: whenever a hit on its holder makes the shield heal, the attacker takes 666 Nature damage plus 5 per Paragon level.

entries.name: Earth Shield: Charging Heals
entries.description: Your direct heals - Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave, Chain Heal and Riptide - add 1 charge to your Earth Shield on each target they heal, up to the shield's maximum.

entries.name: Earth Shield: Unlimited Targets
entries.description: Your Earth Shield no longer disappears from its earlier target when you cast it on another: you can keep it on any number of allies.

entries.name: Healing Stream: Surge
entries.description: When you heal the spirit of your Healing Stream Totem with Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave, Chain Heal or Riptide, allies in your group within 10 yards of it receive 75% of that heal, and your Healing Stream Totem heals for 25% more for 30 seconds. Stacks up to 10 times.

entries.name: Deep Reserves
entries.description: Your mana regeneration is increased by 2% for every 1% of mana you are missing.

entries.name: Arcane Barrage: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Arcane Barrage by 50%.

entries.name: Arcane Barrage: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Arcane Barrage jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Arcane Blast: -50% Cast Time
entries.description: Reduces the cast time of your Arcane Blast by 50%.

entries.name: Arcane Blast: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Arcane Blast jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Arcane Blast: 8 Charges
entries.description: Arcane Blast's effect stacks up to 8 times instead of 4.

entries.name: Arcane Explosion: Charges
entries.description: Arcane Explosion adds a stack of Arcane Blast's effect, like Arcane Blast itself.

entries.name: Evocation Power
entries.description: Each tick of Evocation increases your damage done by 20% for 1 min. Stacks up to 4 times.

entries.name: Emergency Mana Shield
entries.description: Taking damage while at or below 30% health activates Mana Shield and restores all your mana. Can occur once every 60 sec.

entries.name: Blink: To Your Target
entries.description: Blink teleports you to your selected target if it is within 30 yards and in line of sight.

entries.name: Arcane Overflow
entries.description: Every 10,000 mana you spend unleashes an empowered Arcane Explosion that deals twice the damage, and resets the cooldown of your Blink.

entries.name: Mirror Shield
entries.description: When you are struck while one of your absorb shields is active, there is a 10% chance to summon a Mirror Image. Can occur once every 6 sec.

entries.name: Mirror Images: Splash
entries.description: The spells of your Mirror Images also hit all other enemies within 8 yards of their target.

entries.name: Blink: Mirror Image
entries.description: When you Blink, a Mirror Image appears where you arrive and fights for you for 20 sec.

entries.name: Mirror Images: Strength in Numbers
entries.description: Your Mirror Images deal 5% more damage for each Mirror Image alive.

entries.name: Targeted Blink
entries.description: Teleports you to the selected ground location within 40 yards. Shares a cooldown with Blink.

entries.name: Blink: Through the Enemy
entries.description: When you Blink through an enemy, the cooldown of Blink is reset, but each such Blink costs 5% more mana for 10 sec, up to 10 times. Does not work while you know Targeted Blink.

entries.name: Fireball: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Fireball by 50%.

entries.name: Fireball: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Fireball jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Pyroblast: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Pyroblast jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Pyroblast: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Pyroblast by 50%.

entries.name: Fire Blast: Swift and Sure
entries.description: Your Fire Blast no longer triggers the global cooldown and always lands a critical strike.

entries.name: Pyroblast: Hot Streak
entries.description: Casting Pyroblast with its full cast time grants Hot Streak: your next Pyroblast is instant.

entries.name: Meteor
entries.description: Calls down a meteor at the target location, dealing 3,500 to 4,100 Fire damage to all enemies within 8 yards and burning them for 600 Fire damage over 6 sec. 45 sec cooldown.

entries.name: Dragon's Breath: Living Bomb
entries.description: Enemies hit by your Dragon's Breath also receive your Living Bomb (highest rank you know).

entries.name: Molten Armor: Flamestrike
entries.description: While Molten Armor is active, your damage has a 5% chance to cast a free Flamestrike on the target. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Frostbolt: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Frostbolt by 50%.

entries.name: Frostbolt: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Frostbolt jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Ice Lance: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Ice Lance by 50%.

entries.name: Ice Lance: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Ice Lance jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Water Elemental: Permanent
entries.description: Your Water Elemental stays until it dies or is dismissed.

entries.name: Comet Shower
entries.description: Calls down Frost Comets on the target location, striking every enemy within 15 yards of it.

entries.name: Ice Block: Ice Lance Barrage
entries.description: While you are in Ice Block, a free Ice Lance flies at every enemy within 25 yards every 0.5 sec.

entries.name: Ice Block: Detonation
entries.description: When your Ice Block ends it detonates, dealing Frost damage to all enemies within 10 yards. The damage increases with your Paragon level.

entries.name: Shadow Eruption
entries.description: Your damage-over-time effects have a 20% chance on each tick to erupt, dealing 666 Shadow damage plus 5 per Paragon level to all other enemies within 10 yards of the target. Can occur once every 2 sec.

entries.name: Corruption: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Corruption by 50%.

entries.name: Spreading Affliction
entries.description: Your damage-over-time effects have a 15% chance on each tick to spread to up to 2 other enemies within 10 yards. Can occur once every 3 sec.

entries.name: Withering Harvest
entries.description: Each tick of your damage-over-time effects increases the damage of your damage-over-time effects by 1% for 30 sec, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks, every 5 sec a free Drain Life strikes a random enemy in combat within 30 yards, draining 133 health every 1 sec for 5 sec. It is not channeled: your own casts go on.

entries.name: Curse of Agony: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Curse of Agony by 50%.

entries.name: Drain Life: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Drain Life by 50%.

entries.name: Life Tap: Dark Tithe
entries.description: Each Life Tap adds a stack of Dark Tithe for 30 sec, up to 5. Your next Corruption, Curse of Agony, Immolate, Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption deals 10% more damage per stack and uses the stacks up.

entries.name: Drain Life: +9 Targets
entries.description: Each tick of your Drain Life also drains up to 9 other enemies near its target, healing you for every one.

entries.name: Metamorphosis: Feast
entries.description: Each enemy you kill during Metamorphosis extends it by 5 sec, up to 2 min.

entries.name: Metamorphosis: Fel Vigor
entries.description: During Metamorphosis, your Immolation Aura heals you for all the damage it deals, and your demons deal 100% more damage.

entries.name: Lesser Demons
entries.description: Your demon's attacks have a 10% chance to summon a lesser demon that fights for 30 sec. Can occur once every 30 sec.

entries.name: Imp: +50% Damage
entries.description: Your Imp deals 50% more damage.

entries.name: Imp: Firebolt +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Imp's Firebolt also hits up to 9 other enemies within 10 yards of its target.

entries.name: Imp: Firebolt 50% Faster
entries.description: Your Imp casts 50% faster: its Firebolt takes a third less time to cast.

entries.name: Voidwalker: Void Bulwark
entries.description: Your Voidwalker has 500% more health, and while it is in combat it casts Suffering every 10 sec on its own.

entries.name: Succubus: Mass Seduction
entries.description: Your Succubus's Seduction jumps to up to 9 additional enemies, and every enemy it seduces takes 25% more damage for 30 sec. Stacks up to 4 times.

entries.name: Felhunter: Area Spell Lock and Devour Magic
entries.description: Your Felhunter's Spell Lock and Devour Magic also hit every other enemy within 10 yards of their target. A Devour Magic on an ally also cleanses every other ally within 10 yards.

entries.name: Felguard: Unlimited Cleave
entries.description: Your Felguard's Cleave strikes every enemy around it.

entries.name: Felguard: +50% Damage
entries.description: Your Felguard deals 50% more damage.

entries.name: Second Demon
entries.description: When you summon a demon while another one is out, the one that was out stays at your side - two demons at most. It has a control bar of its own and leaves when you dismiss or lose your demon.

entries.name: Shadow Cleave: Unlimited Targets
entries.description: Your Shadow Cleave in Metamorphosis strikes every enemy in front of you within 8 yards instead of only 3.

entries.name: Shadow Cleave: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Cleave in Metamorphosis by 50%.

entries.name: Felhunter: Spell Shackles
entries.description: While your Felhunter is out, the spells of every enemy within 40 yards of it take 25% longer to cast.

entries.name: Demon Charge: Shockwave
entries.description: Your Demon Charge also deals 666 Fire damage plus 5 per Paragon level to every enemy within 10 yards of its target and stuns them for 3 sec. If it kills an enemy, the cooldown of Demon Charge is reset.

entries.name: Shadow Bolt: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Shadow Bolt jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Shadow Bolt: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Shadow Bolt by 50%.

entries.name: Chaos Bolt: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Chaos Bolt by 50%.

entries.name: Chaos Bolt: -2 sec Cooldown
entries.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Chaos Bolt by 2 sec.

entries.name: Chaos Bolt: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Chaos Bolt jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Hellfire: Free Movement
entries.description: Your Hellfire is no longer channeled: for its full duration it burns you and all enemies within 10 yards of you every 1 sec wherever you move, and you can cast other spells meanwhile.

entries.name: Rain of Fire: Around You
entries.description: Your Rain of Fire is no longer channeled: wherever you aim it, it falls around you for its full duration, hitting all enemies within 8 yards of you every 2 sec, and you can move and cast other spells meanwhile.

entries.name: Soul Fire: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Soul Fire by 50%.

entries.name: Soul Fire: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Soul Fire jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Immolate: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Immolate jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Incinerate: Stoked Soul Fire
entries.description: Each Incinerate that hits a target afflicted by your Shadow Immolate makes your next Soul Fire deal 50% more damage, stacking up to 10 times.

entries.name: Shadow Bolt: Shadow Immolate
entries.description: Your Shadow Bolt deals 15% more damage to targets afflicted by your Immolate, and turns the Immolate into Shadow Immolate: twice the damage, dealt as Shadow and Fire, with the time that was left.

entries.name: Moonfire: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Moonfire jumps to up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Moonfire: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Moonfire, including its damage over time, by 50%.

entries.name: Starfall: +50% Area
entries.description: Increases the area of your Starfall by 50%: its stars fall on enemies within 45 yards and their splash hits enemies within 7.5 yards of each star's target.

entries.name: Starfall: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Starfall by 50%.

entries.name: Starfall: Starlight Reset
entries.description: Each time your spells deal damage, the cooldown of your Starfall is reduced by 1 sec. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Starfall: 10 Stacks
entries.description: Casting Starfall while it is active stacks it, up to 10 times: each stack calls down its own stars.

entries.name: Lunar Frenzy
entries.description: In Moonkin Form every killing blow grants Lunar Frenzy for 60 sec: +1% damage and casting speed, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks you cast a free instant Starfire at a random enemy in front of you every 3 sec while in combat.

entries.name: Wrath: Starfire Surge
entries.description: Each Wrath you cast increases the damage of your next Starfire by 10%. Stacks up to 10 times; Starfire uses the stacks up.

entries.name: Force of Nature: Star Owls
entries.description: Force of Nature calls three star owls instead of treants. They fight for you for 30 sec, casting Starfire at your target; their damage grows with your spell power.

entries.name: Swipe (Bear): Bleed
entries.description: Your Swipe in Bear Form makes every enemy it hits bleed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Maul: Bleeding Wounds
entries.description: Your Maul deals 50% more damage to bleeding targets.

entries.name: Swipe (Bear): +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Swipe in Bear Form by 50%.

entries.name: Thorns: Open Wounds
entries.description: When your Thorns damages a bleeding enemy, its wound opens: you deal Physical damage to it that increases with your Paragon level and ignores armor. Can occur once every 5 sec per enemy.

entries.name: Ursine Bulwark
entries.description: Each hit you take in Bear Form grants Ursine Bulwark for 30 sec: +1% maximum health, stacking up to 100 times. At 100 stacks Barkskin stays active on you, and every 100 Rage you spend sends out a quake that deals Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards; the damage increases with your Paragon level.

entries.name: Swipe (Cat): Bleed
entries.description: Your Swipe in Cat Form makes every enemy it hits bleed for 6 sec.

entries.name: Energy: +50% Regeneration
entries.description: Increases your Energy regeneration by 50%.

entries.name: Swipe (Cat): +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Swipe in Cat Form by 50%.

entries.name: Frontal Assault
entries.description: You can use Shred and Ravage from any direction, not only from behind the target.

entries.name: Berserk: Unleashed
entries.description: While Berserk is active your movement speed is increased by 100%, and every finisher you use with 5 combo points unleashes a blow that deals Physical damage to all enemies within 8 yards. The damage increases with your Paragon level.

entries.name: Maul: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Maul by 50%.

entries.name: Maul: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Maul also strikes up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Claw: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Claw by 50%.

entries.name: Claw: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Claw also strikes up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Shred: +50% Damage
entries.description: Increases the damage of your Shred by 50%.

entries.name: Shred: +9 Targets
entries.description: Your Shred also strikes up to 9 additional enemies.

entries.name: Treant Call
entries.description: Your heal-over-time effects have a 5% chance on each tick to call a Healing Treant to fight for you for 30 sec. Can occur once every 5 sec.

entries.name: Summons: Healing Power
entries.description: Your summons gain 10 health for every point of your healing power.

entries.name: Summons: Parting Bloom
entries.description: When one of your summons dies or its time runs out, it heals all allies within 10 yards.

entries.name: Thorns: Rejuvenation
entries.description: When an enemy strikes a target protected by your Thorns, there is a 20% chance you cast Rejuvenation on that target. Can occur once every 3 sec per target.

entries.name: Heal over Time: +50%
entries.description: Increases the periodic healing of your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom and Wild Growth by 50%.

entries.name: Heal over Time: Double Speed
entries.description: Your Rejuvenation, Regrowth, Lifebloom and Wild Growth tick twice as fast and last twice as long.

entries.name: Deep Reserves
entries.description: Your mana regeneration is increased by 2% for every 1% of mana you are missing.

entries.name: Killing Blow: Recovery
entries.description: Killing an enemy heals you for 5% of your maximum health.

entries.name: Extra Attack
entries.description: Your melee attacks have a 25% chance to grant you an extra attack. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Cleaving Strikes
entries.description: Your attacks, shots and harmful spells have a 10% chance to deal their damage to all other enemies within 10 yards of the target as well. Can occur once every 1 sec.

entries.name: Riposte
entries.description: When you avoid an attack - a miss, dodge, parry or block - you counter-attack for 50% of your attack power. Can occur once every 2 sec.

entries.name: Empowered
entries.description: Increases all damage you deal by 5%.
